objective: Readers need a clear sense that each newly visible section is the next stop on one continuous exploration path.
spatial_relationship: The next section settles upward by eight pixels as it crosses the reading threshold, matching forward page travel.

selection_rationale.escalation_reason: Tier zero would remove useful orientation between visually distinct editorial sections; a two-state CSS transition fully expresses the change.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: Distinct sections would snap into view without reinforcing their sequence on the exploration path.

timing.derivation: The container travels only eight pixels and is encountered occasionally while reading, so the approved base duration is enough to orient without slowing scroll comprehension.

easing.character: A quick, quiet settle that feels like arriving at the next stop rather than an animated presentation.

interruption.notes: The effect runs once; fast scrolling leaves the section in its readable end state.

responsive.mobile: Same eight-pixel travel with no stagger; content remains fully laid out before the transition.
responsive.desktop: Same behavior; no increased travel distance.
responsive.orientation_or_input_notes: Keyboard scrolling never delays focus targets or hides content.

reduced_motion.implementation: Static visible state is the default; transition and initial offset exist only inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
reduced_motion.vestibular_review: Small local movement only; no parallax, zoom, pinning, smooth-scroll replacement, or large-area travel.

keyboard_and_focus.focus_behavior: Focus remains untouched and its indicator is immediately visible; focused controls are never translated or delayed.

ssr.initial_state: Content is visible before JavaScript and when IntersectionObserver is unavailable.
ssr.hydration_strategy: Client adds the motion-ready attribute only after mount.

cleanup.unmount_behavior: IntersectionObserver disconnects in the hook cleanup.
cleanup.route_change_behavior: Each route mounts fresh observers and disconnects them on unmount.

performance_budget.cls_contribution: None; every section occupies its final layout space before revealing.
performance_budget.inp_notes: No click handler or navigation waits on the transition.

acceptance_criteria: The section is readable before JavaScript and in reduced-motion mode.
Only opacity and transform animate for 220 milliseconds.
Rapid scrolling cannot leave content hidden.
No horizontal overflow or layout shift appears at the verification viewports.
